<header>秘密經第十一卷上二百二十四</header>
<meta>Xylograph pothi leaf printed in red ink. The page is photographed rotated 90°, so the vertical Mongolian lines run horizontally across the image. The text sits inside a double-ruled frame. The right margin panel has a Chinese marginal title (transcribed in the header tag), and the left margin panel has a short Mongolian marginal label. A modern red-numbered label reading "447" is attached at the upper left, outside the frame.</meta>
<warning>The ink is faint red. The Mongolian text is in Uighur-Mongolian script and is photographed rotated, so it could not be transcribed reliably. Only the Chinese marginal title and the modern label are transcribed.</warning>

translation.text:
<meta>Xylograph leaf from the Mongolian Kanjur, Secret Tantra section, printed in red ink. The page image is rotated 90°. The main Mongolian text was not transcribed, so nothing from the body can be translated here.</meta>
<warning>The main body of this page, about 30 lines of Uighur-Mongolian script, was not transcribed because the red ink is faint and the image is rotated. Only the Chinese marginal title and a modern library label could be read. No translation of the main text is given.</warning>

447

<margin><unclear>short Mongolian marginal label (volume and folio indication), not transcribed</unclear></margin>

<unclear>about 30 lines of Mongolian text in Uighur-Mongolian script with frequent punctuation marks, not transcribed</unclear>

<margin>Secret Tantra, Volume 11, folio 224 recto <note>original: "秘密經第十一卷上二百二十四". This Chinese marginal title is common on Beijing-printed Mongolian Kanjur leaves. It names the section, the Secret Tantras (Mongolian <term>Dandr-a</term> <gloss>Tantra</gloss>), the volume number, and the folio. The character "上" marks the front side of the leaf.</note></margin>

<summary>This is folio 224 recto of volume 11 in the Tantra section of a red-ink xylograph Mongolian Kanjur. Only the Chinese marginal title and a modern label number, 447, can be read. The Mongolian body text was not transcribed.</summary>
<keywords>Mongolian Kanjur, Secret Tantra section, Tantra, xylograph, red ink, Uighur-Mongolian script, Chinese marginal title, volume 11, folio 224, Buddhist canon, Beijing print</keywords>
